fields.step1_body:
AARP asked 1,656 workers over 50.
A third had seen one bias: "less tech-savvy."
Arguing won't change that. Using AI will.
The free Skill Finder shows where to start.
fields.step2_body:
Not the software you used. The judgment.
The calls juniors came to you to make.
Write three of them down.
Then hand one to Claude.
fields.step3_body:
Ask Claude to turn it into a one-page offer.
It writes the draft. You fix what's wrong.
You spot what's wrong because you've done it.
Now show it to one real person.
fields.step4_body:
A former coworker. A local business owner.
Ask: would this help you? What would you pay?
One yes from a real person is a real start.
And a working offer never checks your age.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment {o:SKILLS} and I'll DM you my free Skill Finder: 12 questions, then AI names your 3 most sellable skills.
